segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the final quote for the analytics workspace renewal and make sure the seat count and start date match what your team needs.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 42 users today, and we want to add 8 more for the operations team, so 50 total. We’d like the new term to start April 1 if that’s still available.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, April 1 works. For 50 seats on the professional plan, the annual subscription comes to $38,500, and that includes the standard support package.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation hours we discussed, is that still a separate line item?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is. The onboarding services are 20 hours at $175 an hour, so $3,500. That covers the admin setup, two training sessions, and the dashboard migration review.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine. We’ll need the invoice split between subscription and services, same purchase order, just two lines. Our finance team asked for that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. The invoice can show the $38,500 subscription and $3,500 services separately, with a total of $42,000 before tax. Payment terms are net 30, same as last year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One other thing, the contract term is 12 months, right? April 1 through March 31 next year?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027. Auto-renew is included, with 30 days’ notice if you don’t want to renew.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send me the order form today, and I can route it for signature. Our VP is available Thursday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the order form and the services description after this call. If it’s signed by Thursday, we can schedule the kickoff for April 3 or April 4.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: April 4 is better. Let’s pencil that in, and I’ll confirm once the signature is done.
